fields.description: Palace Villas – Ostra brings four to six bedroom detached homes to The Oasis, with waterways, gardens and shared leisure spaces shaping the neighbourhood. The Palace-branded collection offers Classic, Chamfer and Contemporary designs, including basement and drop-type layouts. Glass façades and natural stone are paired with interiors in soft tones.

reviewCoverage.identity: Official Palace Villas – Ostra project page reviewed; branded community distinguished from a guaranteed hotel-service package.
reviewCoverage.location: The Oasis, Dubai; official brochure map reviewed. A dedicated community filter registered without assigning coordinates.
reviewCoverage.residences: Four to six bedroom villas; Classic, Chamfer and Contemporary variants, with basement and drop-type configurations distinguished.
reviewCoverage.areas: All 12 layout tables in the 13-page official plan pack reviewed; representative layout rendered. Total areas include carports and terraces/balconies. Plot averages recorded separately from the copied fact sheet.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Developer page and brochure supply the lagoon, parks, clubhouse, sports and wellness facilities. Community amenities are not represented as private villa inclusions.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Official advertised AED 13.13 million retained. Bedroom-specific launch prices attributed to the copied Emaar fact sheet; not claimed as available offers.
reviewCoverage.payment: Copied Emaar fact sheet visually checked; historical dated instalments total 100%. PF corroborates 10/70/20; conflicting broker relative-month schedules not merged.
reviewCoverage.handover: September 2029 estimated construction completion in copied launch schedule and PF, displayed as reported Q3 2029.
reviewCoverage.documents: Official brochure and plans linked, fact/payment copy separately attributed. An image-based sales presentation was located but not used as claim evidence. Images unchanged.

overview: Water and planted open spaces are central to the community plan. The brochure identifies a lagoon, clubhouse, Water Stream Park and Spring Garden, alongside play and sports areas. The villas use broad glazing and natural stone, while interiors favour quieter colours and contrasting textures. The Palace name identifies the branded setting; particular hospitality services, inclusions and charges need confirmation for the selected home.
research.locationNote: The development sits within The Oasis in Dubai. Emaar’s map places it within the wider road network serving Dubai Marina, Dubai Hills and Al Maktoum International Airport. Published journey estimates differ between launch documents and the current brochure, so they are not treated as fixed commuting times.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises AED 13.13 million as the starting price. The launch sheet’s four, five and six bedroom figures were AED 13.13 million, AED 14.56 million and AED 24.05 million respectively. These are reference prices, not confirmed live offers.
research.paymentNote: The launch schedule sets 10% at booking, seven further 10% instalments and 20% at estimated completion. Several dates have passed. Confirm the current agreement and outstanding sums for a specific unit before relying on this historical schedule.
research.handoverNote: September 2029 is the estimated construction-completion month in the copied launch fact sheet, also reported by Property Finder. It is not a contractual handover guarantee.

facts.label: Launch collection
facts.value: The fact sheet lists 526 detached villas: 213 four bedroom, 251 five bedroom and 62 six bedroom homes. This is the launch composition, not remaining inventory.

facts.label: Plot sizes are separate
facts.value: Average launch plots are 9,081 sq ft for four bedrooms, 11,128 sq ft for five and 16,375 sq ft for six. The layout table reports total built areas, not plot areas.

facts.label: Reading the plan totals
facts.value: Totals include terraces/balconies and carports. Basement, ground, first and roof levels vary by type; landscaped illustrations are not a final specification.
